basic scrëen is a cost-effective urinal screen designed to deodorize urinals and prevent debris buildup. Manufactured from a proprietary material infused with a deodorant-based fragrance, it provides a gradual fragrance release for up to 30 days, making it an ideal solution for monthly urinal maintenance.

Manufactured with recycled and 100% recyclable EVA plastic, basic scrëen is also biodegradable with the Eco-One™ additive, ensuring 93% decomposition within 3.5 years (99% within 5 years) in bioactive landfills. Additionally, it is packaged in an eco-friendly cellophane bag, offering an eco-friendly disposal solution.

basic scrëen provides a practical, cost-effective, and environmentally responsible solution for urinal hygiene and odor control.

Key benefits:

  • Proprietary material infused with a deodorant-based fragrance that releases gradually
  • Fragrance release for up to 30 days
  • Ideal for monthly urinal maintenance
  • Suitable for waterless urinals
  • Flexible shape fits almost all types of urinals
  • Unique design, wide range of colors, and pleasant fragrances
  • Significant cost savings
  • 100% recyclable and also biodegradable
  • Packaged in an eco-friendly cellophane bag
  • Complies with European VOC standards
  • Non-toxic to the environment, particularly water sources
  • Option for private branding through material cutouts and printing

xcrën is a NON-PARA puck urinal screen designed for effective odor control and drainage protection. Unlike traditional PARA-based products, it is free from paradichlorobenzene (PARA), a compound classified as possibly carcinogenic by the WHO. Its unique X-shaped design prevents solids and debris from clogging the drainage system while ensuring a clean and fresh fragrance release after each use for up to 30 days.

The puck is made from eco-friendly ingredients, primarily wax and glycerin, making it a safe and sustainable choice. As a disposable product, the puck is designed for single-use and cannot be replaced.

xcrën provides a safe, effective, and environmentally conscious solution for maintaining freshness and hygiene in urinals.

Key benefits:

  • NON-PARA Puck (PARA stands for paradichlorobenzene = possibly carcinogenic according to the WHO)
  • Prevents solids and other debris from clogging the drainage
  • Releasing clean & fresh fragrance after each use for up to 30 days
  • Ideal for monthly urinal maintenance
  • Puck is manufactured of nature-friendly ingredients mostly wax and glycerin
  • Disposable - the puck cannot be replaced with a new one
  • Packaged in an eco-friendly cellophane bag
  • Complies European VOC standards
  • A new unique X design
  • Option for private branding through material cutouts and printing

ëz trap is an innovative cartridge system designed to enhance the efficiency, cleanliness, and odor control of waterless urinals while significantly reducing maintenance costs.

Featuring the patented ëz trap Cartridge System, it allows urine to flow naturally through the siphon, with a closing cap that seals after each use. This prevents odors from escaping and ensures that with every use, old urine is removed from the system, maintaining a fresher restroom environment.

ëz trap offers an efficient, low-maintenance, and cost-saving solution for maintaining odor-free, waterless urinals.

 

Key benefits:

  • Eliminates odors – the siphon and cap system prevent unpleasant drainage smells
  • No need for costly gels or specialized cleaners
  • Easy and cost-effective maintenance – simply pour a glass of water daily to prevent calcium buildup
  • Long-lasting durability – cartridge lasts 4 to 6+ months, with extended lifespan possible through regular cleaning with an anti-calcium agent (e.g., quality toilet gel)
  • Universal compatibility – suitable for Sloan, Falcon, Vitra, Bobrick, and other brands using the Falcon Velocity system (diamater 11.8 cm, height 11.5 cm)

Its unique waterdrop-shaped design complements any restroom interior, while the included adhesive tape allows for easy installation on almost any surface.

Additionally, it is packaged in ane co-friendly cellophane bag, making it an environmentally friendly choice.
